This item weighs over 20kg, please ensure you have suitable assistance and transport when collecting from store.

Easy-to-use levelling screed. Apply up to a bed depth of 50mm (3-50mm in one application). Simply add water and mix. Can be used internally on various substrates to either level or raise the height of an existing floor. Walkable in 4-6 hours. Ideal for creating a smooth finish in preparation to receive floor coverings. Can receive tiles after 4-12 hours and vinyl/wood floor coverings after 24-72 hours.
b: Can be Used with Underfloor Heating
Can Receive Vinyl/Wood Coverings after 24-72 Hours
